# DataAnnotations Validation Cheat Sheet


## Overview of All Validation Attributes


```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DataAnnotations Categories                       │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                               │
│  1. Required/Optional      [Required], [AllowNull]            │
│  2. String Validation      [StringLength], [RegularExpression]│
│  3. Numeric Validation     [Range], [Phone], [CreditCard]     │
│  4. Comparison Validation  [Compare]                          │
│  5. Data Type Validation   [EmailAddress], [Url], [DataType]  │
│  6. Custom Validation      [CustomValidation], IValidatable   │
│                                                               │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```


## Required/Optional Validation


```csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

public record Patient
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Required] - Value must not be null
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Required]
    public string HospitalNumber { get; init; }
    
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Patient name is required")]
    public string Name { get; init; }
    
    [Required(AllowEmptyStrings = false)]  // Also rejects empty strings
    public string AccessionNumber { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // Nullable properties (no [Required])
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    public string? MiddleName { get; init; }  // Optional
    public int? ReferringPhysicianId { get; init; }  // Optional
}
```


## String Validation


```csharp
public record DicomStudy
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [StringLength] - Min/Max length
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [StringLength(100)]  // Max 100 characters
    public string PatientName { get; init; }
    
    [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 16)]  // Between 16-64 chars
    public string StudyInstanceUID { get; init; }
    
    [StringLength(20, MinimumLength = 6, 
        ErrorMessage = "Accession number must be 6-20 characters")]
    public string AccessionNumber { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [MinLength] / [MaxLength] - Alternative
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [MinLength(3)]
    public string Modality { get; init; }
    
    [MaxLength(500)]
    public string StudyDescription { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [RegularExpression] - Pattern matching
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [RegularExpression(@"^[0-9.]+$", 
        ErrorMessage = "UID must contain only digits and dots")]
    public string SopInstanceUID { get; init; }
    
    [RegularExpression(@"^[A-Z]{2}\d{6}$",
        ErrorMessage = "HN format: XX123456")]
    public string HN { get; init; }
    
    [RegularExpression(@"^(CT|MR|XR|US|NM|PT|MG)$",
        ErrorMessage = "Invalid modality code")]
    public string ModalityCode { get; init; }
    
    // DICOM Date format: YYYYMMDD
    [RegularExpression(@"^\d{8}$",
        ErrorMessage = "Date must be in YYYYMMDD format")]
    public string StudyDate { get; init; }
    
    // DICOM Time format: HHMMSS
    [RegularExpression(@"^\d{6}$",
        ErrorMessage = "Time must be in HHMMSS format")]
    public string StudyTime { get; init; }
}
```


## Numeric Validation


```csharp
public record ImagingParameters
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Range] - Min/Max values
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Range(0, 150)]  // Age between 0-150
    public int PatientAge { get; init; }
    
    [Range(1, 10000)]  // Image dimensions
    public int Rows { get; init; }
    
    [Range(0.0, 1000.0)]  // Radiation dose (mGy)
    public double ExposureDose { get; init; }
    
    [Range(typeof(decimal), "0.01", "999999.99")]  // For decimal
    public decimal ExaminationFee { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Phone] - Phone number format
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Phone]
    public string? ContactNumber { get; init; }
    
    [Phone(ErrorMessage = "Invalid phone number")]
    public string? EmergencyContact { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [CreditCard] - Credit card validation
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [CreditCard]
    public string? PaymentCard { get; init; }
}
```


## Comparison Validation


```csharp
public record UserRegistration
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Compare] - Must match another property
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Required]
    [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 8)]
    public string Password { get; init; }
    
    [Compare("Password", ErrorMessage = "Passwords don't match")]
    public string ConfirmPassword { get; init; }
    
    [EmailAddress]
    public string Email { get; init; }
    
    [Compare("Email", ErrorMessage = "Email addresses don't match")]
    public string ConfirmEmail { get; init; }
}

public record AppointmentSchedule
{
    [Required]
    public DateTime StartTime { get; init; }
    
    // EndTime must equal StartTime (could use custom validation instead)
    [Compare("StartTime")]  
    public DateTime EndTime { get; init; }
}
```


## Data Type & Format Validation


```csharp
public record ContactInformation
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [EmailAddress] - Email format
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [EmailAddress]
    public string? Email { get; init; }
    
    [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "Invalid email format")]
    public string? AlternateEmail { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Url] - URL format
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Url]
    public string? WebsiteUrl { get; init; }
    
    [Url(ErrorMessage = "Invalid PACS URL")]
    public string? PacsServerUrl { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [DataType] - Semantic hints (no validation)
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [DataType(DataType.Date)]
    public DateTime BirthDate { get; init; }
    
    [DataType(DataType.Time)]
    public TimeSpan AppointmentTime { get; init; }
    
    [DataType(DataType.Password)]
    public string Password { get; init; }
    
    [DataType(DataType.MultilineText)]
    public string ClinicalHistory { get; init; }
    
    [DataType(DataType.Currency)]
    public decimal Fee { get; init; }
    
    [DataType(DataType.PhoneNumber)]
    public string Phone { get; init; }
}
```


## Collection Validation


```csharp
public record ImagingOrder
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [MinLength] / [MaxLength] - For collections
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [MinLength(1, ErrorMessage = "At least one image required")]
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "Maximum 100 images per study")]
    public List<string> ImageIds { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    [MinLength(1)]
    public List<string> Modalities { get; init; }
}
```


## Custom Validation


### Option A: [CustomValidation] Attribute


```csharp
public record DicomImage
{
    [Required]
    public string SopInstanceUID { get; init; }
    
    [Range(1, 10000)]
    public int Rows { get; init; }
    
    [Range(1, 10000)]
    public int Columns { get; init; }
    
    // Custom validation method
    [CustomValidation(typeof(DicomImage), nameof(ValidateImageSize))]
    public int ImageSize => Rows * Columns;
    
    public static ValidationResult? ValidateImageSize(int size, ValidationContext context)
    {
        // Maximum 100 megapixels
        if (size > 100_000_000)
        {
            return new ValidationResult(
                "Image size exceeds 100 megapixels",
                new[] { context.MemberName }
            );
        }
        
        return ValidationResult.Success;
    }
}
```


### Option B: IValidatableObject Interface


```csharp
public record RadiologyReport : IValidatableObject
{
    [Required]
    public string AccessionNumber { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    public DateTime StudyDate { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    public DateTime ReportDate { get; init; }
    
    public bool IsUrgent { get; init; }
    
    [StringLength(5000)]
    public string Findings { get; init; }
    
    // Complex cross-property validation
    public IEnumerable<ValidationResult> Validate(ValidationContext validationContext)
    {
        // Report date cannot be before study date
        if (ReportDate < StudyDate)
        {
            yield return new ValidationResult(
                "Report date cannot be before study date",
                new[] { nameof(ReportDate) }
            );
        }
        
        // Urgent reports must be completed within 24 hours
        if (IsUrgent && (ReportDate - StudyDate).TotalHours > 24)
        {
            yield return new ValidationResult(
                "Urgent reports must be completed within 24 hours",
                new[] { nameof(IsUrgent), nameof(ReportDate) }
            );
        }
        
        // Findings required for urgent reports
        if (IsUrgent && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Findings))
        {
            yield return new ValidationResult(
                "Findings are required for urgent reports",
                new[] { nameof(Findings) }
            );
        }
    }
}
```


### Option C: Custom Validation Attribute


```csharp
// Create your own attribute
public class DicomUidAttribute : ValidationAttribute
{
    protected override ValidationResult? IsValid(object? value, ValidationContext validationContext)
    {
        if (value is not string uid)
            return new ValidationResult("UID must be a string");
        
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uid))
            return new ValidationResult("UID cannot be empty");
        
        // DICOM UID format: digits and dots only, max 64 chars
        if (!System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(uid, @"^[0-9.]+$"))
            return new ValidationResult("UID must contain only digits and dots");
        
        if (uid.Length > 64)
            return new ValidationResult("UID cannot exceed 64 characters");
        
        // Cannot start or end with dot
        if (uid.StartsWith('.') || uid.EndsWith('.'))
            return new ValidationResult("UID cannot start or end with a dot");
        
        return ValidationResult.Success;
    }
}

// Usage
public record DicomSeries
{
    [DicomUid]
    public string SeriesInstanceUID { get; init; }
    
    [DicomUid]
    public string StudyInstanceUID { get; init; }
}
```


## Complete Reference Table


```
┌──────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Attribute                │ Purpose                                │
├──────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Required]               │ Value must not be null                 │
│ [StringLength(max)]      │ String max length                      │
│ [StringLength(max, Min)] │ String length range                    │
│ [MinLength(n)]           │ Min length (string or collection)      │
│ [MaxLength(n)]           │ Max length (string or collection)      │
│ [Range(min, max)]        │ Numeric range validation               │
│ [RegularExpression]      │ Pattern matching                       │
│ [Compare("Property")]    │ Must match another property            │
│ [EmailAddress]           │ Valid email format                     │
│ [Phone]                  │ Valid phone format                     │
│ [Url]                    │ Valid URL format                       │
│ [CreditCard]             │ Valid credit card number               │
│ [DataType]               │ Semantic hint (no validation)          │
│ [CustomValidation]       │ Custom validation method               │
│ IValidatableObject       │ Complex object-level validation        │
│ ValidationAttribute      │ Create custom attribute                │
└──────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────┘
```


## Display & Formatting Attributes (Not Validation)


These don't validate but are useful for UI and metadata:

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

public record PatientRecord
{
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Display] - UI display metadata
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Display(Name = "Hospital Number")]
    public string HN { get; init; }
    
    [Display(Name = "Date of Birth", Order = 1)]
    public DateTime DOB { get; init; }
    
    [Display(GroupName = "Contact Information")]
    [Display(Prompt = "Enter email address")]
    public string Email { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [DisplayFormat] - Format hints
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [DisplayFormat(DataFormatString = "{0:yyyy-MM-dd}")]
    public DateTime StudyDate { get; init; }
    
    [DisplayFormat(DataFormatString = "{0:C}", ApplyFormatInEditMode = true)]
    public decimal Fee { get; init; }
    
    [DisplayFormat(NullDisplayText = "Not specified")]
    public string? MiddleName { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Description] - Tooltip/help text
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Description("Patient's unique hospital identifier")]
    public string PatientId { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [Editable] - UI editability hint
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [Editable(false)]
    public string SystemGeneratedId { get; init; }
    
    
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    // [ScaffoldColumn] - Hide from auto-generated UI
    // ────────────────────────────────────────
    [ScaffoldColumn(false)]
    public string InternalNotes { get; init; }
}
```


## Real-World Example: Complete DICOM Study Record


```csharp
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

public record DicomStudyRequest : IValidatableObject
{
    // Basic required fields
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Study Instance UID is required")]
    [RegularExpression(@"^[0-9.]+$", ErrorMessage = "Invalid UID format")]
    [StringLength(64, ErrorMessage = "UID too long (max 64 chars)")]
    public string StudyInstanceUID { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    [RegularExpression(@"^[A-Z]{2}\d{6}$", ErrorMessage = "HN format: XX123456")]
    public string HN { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    [StringLength(100)]
    public string PatientName { get; init; }
    
    [Range(0, 150, ErrorMessage = "Age must be 0-150")]
    public int PatientAge { get; init; }
    
    // DICOM specific
    [Required]
    [RegularExpression(@"^(CT|MR|XR|US|NM|PT|MG|CR|DX)$")]
    public string Modality { get; init; }
    
    [Required]
    [RegularExpression(@"^\d{8}$", ErrorMessage = "Use YYYYMMDD format")]
    public string StudyDate { get; init; }
    
    [RegularExpression(@"^\d{6}$", ErrorMessage = "Use HHMMSS format")]
    public string? StudyTime { get; init; }
    
    [StringLength(16)]
    public string AccessionNumber { get; init; }
    
    [StringLength(64)]
    public string? StudyDescription { get; init; }
    
    // Technical parameters
    [Range(1, 10000)]
    public int? ImageRows { get; init; }
    
    [Range(1, 10000)]
    public int? ImageColumns { get; init; }
    
    [Range(1, 10000)]
    public int NumberOfImages { get; init; }
    
    // Contact info
    [EmailAddress]
    public string? RadiologistEmail { get; init; }
    
    [Url]
    public string? PacsUrl { get; init; }
    
    // Complex validation
    public IEnumerable<ValidationResult> Validate(ValidationContext validationContext)
    {
        // Parse study date
        if (DateTime.TryParseExact(StudyDate, "yyyyMMdd", null, 
            System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out var date))
        {
            if (date > DateTime.Now)
            {
                yield return new ValidationResult(
                    "Study date cannot be in the future",
                    new[] { nameof(StudyDate) }
                );
            }
        }
        
        // If dimensions provided, both must be present
        if ((ImageRows.HasValue && !ImageColumns.HasValue) ||
            (!ImageRows.HasValue && ImageColumns.HasValue))
        {
            yield return new ValidationResult(
                "Both rows and columns must be specified if one is provided",
                new[] { nameof(ImageRows), nameof(ImageColumns) }
            );
        }
        
        // Validate modality-specific rules
        if (Modality == "CT" && NumberOfImages < 10)
        {
            yield return new ValidationResult(
                "CT studies typically have at least 10 images",
                new[] { nameof(NumberOfImages) }
            );
        }
    }
}
```


## Quick Reference Card


```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                  DATAANNOTATIONS QUICK REF                   ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                              ║
║  STRING                                                      ║
║  ├─ [Required]                   Not null/empty              ║
║  ├─ [StringLength(max, Min=n)]   Length range                ║
║  └─ [RegularExpression(pattern)] Pattern match               ║
║                                                              ║
║  NUMERIC                                                     ║
║  ├─ [Range(min, max)]            Value range                 ║
║  ├─ [Phone]                      Phone format                ║
║  └─ [CreditCard]                 Credit card                 ║
║                                                              ║
║  COMPARISON                                                  ║
║  └─ [Compare("Property")]        Match another field         ║
║                                                              ║
║  FORMAT                                                      ║
║  ├─ [EmailAddress]               Email format                ║
║  └─ [Url]                        URL format                  ║
║                                                              ║
║  CUSTOM                                                      ║
║  ├─ [CustomValidation]           Call custom method          ║
║  ├─ IValidatableObject           Implement Validate()        ║
║  └─ ValidationAttribute          Create custom attribute     ║
║                                                              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```


**Remember:** These attributes do nothing automatically - you must validate manually or use ASP.NET Core/EF Core!
